cast.note: One elector from the District of Columbia abstained.
One elector from Minnesota voted for John Edwards.
Seven electors voted for other people: five from Washington and Hawaii pledged to Clinton, two from Texas pledged to Trump.

notes.12-2000: Statewide figures are the certified result. County figures come from an earlier count and add up to a 202-vote Gore lead.
